kansei-university-websites.title: Kansei Engineering for University Websites
kansei-university-websites.description: Master's research at the University of Tsukuba exploring how international students perceive and interact with Japanese university websites. The study combines Kansei Engineering with user evaluations and mouse-tracking data to examine how website design influences perception, usability, and the overall browsing experience.
kansei-university-websites.imageAlt: Research on Kansei Engineering and user interaction with Japanese university websites

mouse-tracking.title: Behavioral Mouse Tracking Tool
mouse-tracking.description: Developed a Python-based research tool to collect and analyze user interaction data during web browsing studies. The tool records sampled mouse movement, clicks, scrolling, and session metrics, with a PySide6 interface for experiment setup and automatic heatmap generation for behavioral analysis.

take-command-hra.title: Take Command HRA Hub
take-command-hra.description: Contributed to Take Command's HRA Hub, a platform that helps employers manage HRA benefits and employees find and enroll in health insurance plans. Worked primarily on the employee enrollment experience, building and improving React and TypeScript features across the plan shopping and enrollment flow.
take-command-hra.imageAlt: Take Command HRA Hub employee health insurance enrollment platform
take-command-hra.note: Take Command product screenshot. I contributed to the development of the employee enrollment experience.

efax-corporate.title: eFax Corporate
efax-corporate.description: Contributed to eFax Corporate, Consensus Cloud Solutions' enterprise cloud fax platform for securely sending, receiving, and managing business documents. Worked across front-end and full-stack features, maintaining and improving the web application and its user workflows.
efax-corporate.note: eFax Corporate product image © Consensus Cloud Solutions. Displayed for portfolio purposes.

tic-tac-toe.title: Tic Tac Toe
tic-tac-toe.description: Built an interactive Tic Tac Toe game using React and TypeScript, featuring game-state management, winner detection, turn tracking, and board reset functionality.
tic-tac-toe.imageAlt: Tic Tac Toe interface showing the game board and player information

disney-characters.title: Disney Character Search
disney-characters.description: Built a React application for browsing and searching Disney characters using the Disney API, with debounced search, favorites, pagination, and data fetching with React Query.
disney-characters.imageAlt: Disney characters featured in the character search project

education.description: Research focused on Kansei Engineering, User Experience (UX), and User-Centered Web Design, exploring how digital experiences can better respond to users' perceptions and needs.

Developed pixel-accurate, responsive interfaces from Figma designs and contributed UI improvements focused on usability and visual consistency.
Collaborated with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and backend developers while improving component maintainability and reusable front-end architecture.

experience.description: Contributed to new features for the Blackboard learning management platform as part of an Agile development team.

Resolved 30+ production issues by investigating root causes and deploying fixes that improved application stability, usability, and reliability.

experience.description: Supported database improvements, software architecture documentation, and the development of a business intelligence web application.
